ownerStatement: Asked on 14 November 2026 whether he approves Amiga 0.3.0-experimental for release with worst-case cycles, a full hardware qualification of this exact build and complete memory bounds waived, the owner answered "yes"; earlier that day, after playing it on his MKII: "It's really good!! let's release it if the cpu load now isn't bad".
reason: Update of an experimental USB-only track machine: STR gains SYNC, which moves the stretch at the project's tempo over the sample's ORIGINAL TEMPO and is the default for new tracks, and a note counts as looped by stock's own voice state, so LOOP on AUTO follows the sample. Written by Claude at the owner's request in the session of 14 November 2026. Worst-case cycles on the chip, a full hardware qualification of this exact build and complete memory bounds are waived for this source and version, as for 0.2.0 and 0.2.1. What exists: the module's 75 host checks pass, generate.py --check passes, modules:compat finds no problem, and the release package acae3fef ran as a RAM trial on the owner's MKII on a development twin of the release base on 14 November 2026: the owner compared SYNC with FLEX's time-stretch by ear at the loop point, the default read SYNC, and one track on SYNC read 36.5 % of the frame interrupt against 29.1 % on FLEX, no render skipped. The UI captures are of this version. TESTING.md lists what was not tried, among it a Keep and a power cycle, more than one track, slices and RATE with SYNC, and one unexplained crash of an earlier build of this source on a twin that carried a base change under test.
